system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. Choose one of the following tags: [Flame] [Cold] [Shock] [Blight] [Holy] [Spirit]. The target gains [Cancel (Chosen Tag)] with a rating equal to [[INT mod]xSR].

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A magic that develops a powerful force field around you that conflicts with specific attributes, and grants various resistances to surrounding allies.
